description.source: Inspect a stored answer, source decisions and payment receipt in about two minutes.
description.text: 约两分钟查看存储答案、来源决策及付款收据。

landingLink.source: New here? Follow a recorded research job
landingLink.text: 初次访问？跟踪已记录研究任务

badge.source: Recorded owner QA · Arc mainnet · October 8, 2026
badge.text: 已记录所有者 QA · Arc 主网 · 2026 年 10 月 8 日

introduction.source: Follow an existing public example without a wallet or sign-up. This page opens stored evidence; it does not start research or make a payment.
introduction.text: 无需钱包或注册，跟踪现有公开示例。此页打开存储证据，不开始研究或付款。

limitation.source: This is a partial first-party QA result, not an accepted customer task. The recording and guidance are curated; the answer, decisions and receipt are retained records.
limitation.text: 这是部分第一方 QA 结果，不是已接受客户任务。录制及指导经编排；答案、决策及收据为保留记录。

finished.source: You have reached the end of the recorded example.
finished.text: 您已到达记录示例末尾。

steps.0.title.source: Read the answer and its limits

steps.0.body.source: The QA question asks how source-access tolls differ from citation rewards. The answer cites Keryx Engineering, a first-party source, with exact [S1] excerpts.
steps.0.body.text: QA 问题询问来源访问费与引用奖励的区别。答案引用第一方来源 Keryx Engineering，含确切 [S1] 摘录。

steps.0.limit.source: The report is marked Low confidence and omits the requested document revision. A cited answer does not mean the complete task was delivered or accepted.
steps.0.limit.text: 报告标记低置信度，省略请求的文档修订。带引用答案不意味着完整任务已交付或接受。

steps.0.action.source: Open the report and compare its statements with the quoted source text.
steps.0.action.text: 打开报告，将陈述与引用来源文本比较。

steps.1.body.source: Expand Decision log on the report. Keryx recorded CACHE for the Engineering article and SKIP for unrelated candidates, with its reasons.
steps.1.body.text: 在报告展开决策日志。Keryx 对 Engineering 文章记录 CACHE，对无关候选记录 SKIP，并说明原因。

steps.1.limit.source: This example made no new paid access purchase. CACHE avoided an access toll while a citation reward was still allocated. It does not demonstrate a live BUY or replay a decision against another policy.
steps.1.limit.text: 此示例没有新的付费访问购买。CACHE 避免访问费，但仍分配引用奖励。它不演示实时 BUY，也不按另一政策重放决策。

steps.1.action.source: Check the recorded reasons, rather than treating a planned purchase as a completed payment.
steps.1.action.text: 检查记录原因，不要把计划购买当成完成付款。

steps.2.body.source: The checkpoint records one settled citation reward on Arc mainnet. Its source-access cost is zero. These are creator-payment figures for this QA job, not outside-customer revenue or business profit.
steps.2.body.text: 检查点记录一笔 Arc 主网上已结算引用奖励，来源访问成本为零。这是此 QA 任务创作者付款数字，不是外部客户收入或业务利润。

steps.2.limit.source: The Circle transfer ID is a batch-payment reference, not an individual Arc transaction hash. The three checks below are separate: receipt integrity, Circle's own transfer record and the Arc registry's current payout wallet. None of them proves chain finality for this individual payment.
steps.2.limit.text: Circle 转账 ID 是批量付款参考，不是单笔 Arc 交易哈希。下方三项检查独立：收据完整性、Circle 自身转账记录和 Arc 注册表当前收款钱包。均不证明单笔付款链上最终性。

steps.2.action.source: Open the receipt, then run each check. The Circle and Arc checks send one request from your browser to those services, not to Keryx.
steps.2.action.text: 打开收据，再运行各检查。Circle 和 Arc 检查从浏览器向这些服务发送一次请求，不发送给 Keryx。

steps.3.title.source: Follow the money for this job

steps.3.body.source: These figures come from the same retained receipt: what the question authorised, what was paid to open sources, what was paid to the cited creator, and what is still outstanding.
steps.3.body.text: 数字来自同一保留收据：问题授权金额、访问来源付款、被引用创作者付款及尚未解决金额。

steps.3.limit.source: This is a creator-payment view of one owner-operated QA job. Inbound service receipts and model or search costs are not in the receipt, so a margin cannot be calculated here.
steps.3.limit.text: 这是一个所有者操作 QA 任务的创作者付款视图。收据不含入站服务收款及模型或搜索成本，因此无法计算利润率。

steps.3.action.source: Compare these figures with the receipt, then open the public job transfer ledger for current observed transfers.
steps.3.action.text: 将数字与收据比较，再打开公开任务转账账本查看当前观察转账。

citationLabel.text: 记录的已结算引用奖励

circleLabel.text: 记录的 Circle 转账 ID

check.source: Check receipt integrity in this browser
check.text: 在此浏览器检查收据完整性

checking.source: Reading and hashing the current receipt…
checking.text: 正在读取并哈希当前收据…

matched.source: The payload matches the retained checkpoint. This checks integrity only; the Circle and Arc checks read independent records.
matched.text: 载荷匹配保留检查点。仅检查完整性；Circle 和 Arc 检查读取独立记录。

changed.source: The current receipt differs from the checkpoint or fails its integrity check. Inspect both copies; a reconciliation or export change needs review.
changed.text: 当前收据与检查点不同或完整性检查失败。查看两个副本；对账或导出更改需审核。

unavailable.source: The current receipt could not be checked. Use the retained snapshot and recording; no research or payment was requested.
unavailable.text: 无法检查当前收据。使用保留快照及录制；未请求研究或付款。

circleCheck.source: Check Circle's record of this transfer
circleCheck.text: 检查 Circle 的此转账记录

circleNote.source: Reads this transfer from Circle's public Gateway API, not from Keryx, and compares its recipient, amount, token and network with the retained receipt.
circleNote.text: 从 Circle 公开 Gateway API 而非 Keryx 读取转账，并将接收者、金额、代币及网络与保留收据比较。

circleChecking.source: Reading the transfer record from Circle…
circleChecking.text: 正在从 Circle 读取转账记录…

circleCompleted.source: Circle's record matches the receipt: same transfer, recipient, amount, token and Arc mainnet network, and Circle reports it completed. This is Circle's API record, not an individual Arc transaction.
circleCompleted.text: Circle 记录匹配收据：相同转账、接收者、金额、代币及 Arc 主网，Circle 报告完成。这是 Circle API 记录，不是单笔 Arc 交易。

circleProgressing.source: Circle's record matches the receipt, but Circle does not report this transfer as completed. Treat the payment as not final.
circleProgressing.text: Circle 记录匹配收据，但未报告转账完成。请视付款为未最终确认。

circleFailed.source: Circle's record matches the receipt but reports this transfer as failed. The stored receipt needs review.
circleFailed.text: Circle 记录匹配收据，但报告转账失败。存储收据需审核。

circleMismatch.source: Circle's record differs from the receipt in its transfer, recipient, amount, token or network. Do not rely on the stored settlement claim.
circleMismatch.text: Circle 记录的转账、接收者、金额、代币或网络与收据不同。不要依赖存储结算声明。

circleUnavailable.source: Circle's transfer record could not be read from this browser. Nothing was verified; no research or payment was requested.
circleUnavailable.text: 此浏览器无法读取 Circle 转账记录。未核验任何内容；未请求研究或付款。

registryCheck.source: Check the payout wallet on Arc
registryCheck.text: 在 Arc 检查收款钱包

registryNote.source: Reads the cited source from the SourceRegistry contract through the public Arc mainnet RPC and compares its payout wallet with the recorded payee.
registryNote.text: 通过公开 Arc 主网 RPC 从 SourceRegistry 合约读取引用来源，将收款钱包与记录收款人比较。

registryChecking.source: Reading the source registration from Arc mainnet…
registryChecking.text: 正在从 Arc 主网读取来源注册…

registryRegistered.source: Arc mainnet reports this source as active with the recorded payee as its payout wallet. This is the registry's current state, not the state at payment time or a payment transaction.
registryRegistered.text: Arc 主网报告来源已启用，收款钱包为记录收款人。这是注册表当前状态，不是付款时状态或付款交易。

registryChanged.source: Arc mainnet now reports a different payout wallet or an inactive source. A creator may have updated the registration since October 8; compare it with the receipt.
registryChanged.text: Arc 主网现在报告不同收款钱包或未启用来源。创作者可能在 10 月 8 日后更新注册；请与收据比较。

registryUnavailable.source: The Arc registry could not be read from this browser. Nothing was verified; no research or payment was requested.
registryUnavailable.text: 此浏览器无法读取 Arc 注册表。未核验任何内容；未请求研究或付款。

outstandingLabel.text: 记录的待处理或失败付款

costsLabel.source: Service receipts, model and search costs
costsLabel.text: 服务收款、模型及搜索成本

ledgerLink.source: Open the public job transfer ledger
ledgerLink.text: 打开公开任务转账账本

boundaryTitle.text: 此示例仍待解决的内容

boundaryBody.source: This recorded path does not start a new sponsored job, show a budget refusal or a human approval threshold, replay a decision, or prove Arc finality for the individual payment. Model/search costs and service receipts are not in this small view, so a job margin cannot be calculated here.
boundaryBody.text: 此记录路径不开始新赞助任务、不显示预算拒绝或人工批准阈值、不重放决策，也不证明单笔付款 Arc 最终性。此小视图无模型/搜索成本和服务收款，因此无法计算任务利润率。

operatorLink.text: 查看当前 Operator 状态

evidenceLink.source: Read the checkpoint and recording scope
evidenceLink.text: 阅读检查点及录制范围

videoBody.source: The silent 2m40s recording reopens this same partial QA report. It was captured on October 8 at app 0.27.43; it is separate from the currently deployed version.
videoBody.text: 无声 2 分 40 秒录制重新打开同一部分 QA 报告。10 月 8 日在 app 0.27.43 捕获，独立于当前部署版本。

videoLink.text: 观看归档 QA 录制

newQuestionBody.source: Open the research composer and check its current availability, displayed payer and budget before submitting. Sponsored admission can be paused or capped. Submitted questions become public reports.
newQuestionBody.text: 打开研究编辑器，提交前检查当前可用性、显示付款方及预算。赞助接受可暂停或限制。提交问题成为公开报告。

liveCheck.source: Check whether new research is open now
liveCheck.text: 检查目前是否开放新研究

liveChecking.text: 正在读取当前研究可用性…

liveOpen.source: No global research pause was observed just now. Each question still needs server admission and can be refused when its sponsored allowance is spent; this recorded run stays available either way.
liveOpen.text: 刚才未观察到全局研究暂停。每个问题仍需服务器接受，赞助额度耗尽时可拒绝；此记录运行均保持可用。

livePaused.source: New research is paused right now. This recorded run is the available path; nothing was submitted or retried.
livePaused.text: 新研究当前暂停。可使用此记录运行；未提交或重试。

liveUnknown.source: Research availability could not be read. Continue with this recorded run; nothing was submitted.
liveUnknown.text: 无法读取研究可用性。继续此记录运行；未提交。
